listing.name: Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Oratorio Tangram — virtualon_pc (drakenabarion)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports ot boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Completion has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed this component. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS4 CUSA16156 VirtualOnMasterpiece collection folder; select OratorioTangram component ot. Requires decrypted collection eboot.bin/pjv3.elf/modules/assets; update/fingerprints unbound.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the shared VirtualOn AppImage or Windows ZIP, or build from source. Select your own collection folder and ot in the launcher (BB_EXE=ot). The omg and force components are separate games in the collection.

warnings: The project reports ot boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Completion has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed this component.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
